name: miss you
source:
The protaganist is an average young man with nothing distinctive about him. But his house is famous in his neighborhood for having a bunch of weirdos in it; his playboy big brother who has broken the hearts of hundreds of women, his gambler uncle who is terrible with money, his step-mother who lives to cheat people, and his father who has such a severe nurse fetish that he keeps getting hospitalized to meet them. He lives in a terrible environment where his family uses him as a plaything.

One day, his stepmother dies and his father is once again single. He says he's going to marry a nurse he's had his eye on for a while. She's a widow with two daughters, and now they'll all be living together. Thus, this house of eccentrics has gained two new members. But there's a very important secret that the protagonist's father has failed to tell him about his new family...

[Translation of synopsis from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=9844]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
主人公只是一名平凡青年，身上没有任何特别之处。然而，他家却因为住着一群怪人而在附近出了名：玩弄感情、伤透数百名女性心的花花公子哥哥；嗜赌成性、完全不会管钱的叔叔；以坑蒙拐骗为乐的继母；还有恋护士癖严重到为了见护士而不断住院的父亲。他生活在糟糕透顶的环境中，家里人总把他当成玩具折腾。

一天，继母去世，父亲再次恢复单身。他宣称要娶一名自己关注已久的护士。对方是一名带着两个女儿的寡妇，今后母女三人都将搬来同住。于是，这座怪人之家又迎来了两名新成员。然而，关于这个新家庭，主人公的父亲忘记告诉他一个至关重要的秘密……

[根据[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=9844]Getchu.com[/url]上的简介翻译]
